targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['status'] = 'red') = 1, 3, argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['status'] = 'yellow') = 1, 2, 1) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.cluster.health' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.cluster.nodes' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.cluster.data_nodes' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'active') AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.cluster.shards' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 1048576, 2) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.index.shards.size' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.index.documents' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round(maxIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'used') / 1048576, 2) AS used_mb, round(maxIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'free') / 1048576, 2) AS free_mb FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.os.memory' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round((maxIf(Value, Attributes['operation'] = 'index') - minIf(Value, Attributes['operation'] = 'index')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 4) AS index_ops_per_sec, round((maxIf(Value, Attributes['operation'] = 'query') - minIf(Value, Attributes['operation'] = 'query')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 4) AS query_ops_per_sec FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.index.operations.completed' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS open_connections FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.node.http.connections' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS queued_tasks FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.node.thread_pool.tasks.queued' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.free') / 1048576, 2) AS free_mb, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.total') / 1048576, 2) AS total_mb FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.free','elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.total') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, multiIf(maxIf(Value, Attributes['status'] = 'red') = 1, 3, maxIf(Value, Attributes['status'] = 'yellow') = 1, 2, 1) AS health FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'elasticsearch.cluster.health' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
